info.name: Korean Folk Town : Through the Sky

descriptions.notStarted: How about going to the Korean Folk Town through the sky?
descriptions.inProgress: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Camila said she'll give me a few essential items for the trip. What must those be?
descriptions.completed: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Okay, so I first go from #bEllinia#k to #bOrbis#k, then to #bLudibrium#k? And once I get there, I'm supposed to walk my way down there through #bHelios Tower#k. That's pretty far...
